source.title: Northern Whig, 9 May 1914, p. 10 ("Rural Councils: Newry No 2")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1914. The report names only the members "returned yesterday" for these four divisions and a contest in Forkhill (John Smith, John Joseph Murdock, Thomas Heaney), whose result was not found; the other divisions were not found. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Only "Mr. Fisher" (an old member) is named as returned for the division.
